name: Mukta Agriculture Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Mukta Agriculture Ltd does trading in Agriculture products and other related activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MAL is in the business of trading in agricultural goods, natural resources, and deals in agro & allied products. It started as a venture in lease farming and trading of agricultural products, which is executed through its retail outlets and franchise agreements.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.27 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 11.2% over last 3 years.
